schema.description: Download links for downloading the browser as part of a backup recovery.

download_url.description:
The URL to download a new copy of the browser for the update channel. This URL
may include attribution codes.
download_url.title: Download URL

update_channel.description:
The name of the update channel for the browser that the backup was created on.
For example: "release", "beta", "esr"
update_channel.title: Update channel name
